signals.name: Alphabet
signals.label: Broadest whale convergence continues; Congress stays split
signals.detail: Berkshire's Q2 2026 13F added ~$17B to Alphabet (incl. a rare direct private placement), making it the 4th-largest holding; Duquesne/Druckenmiller also added a new Alphabet stake alongside its IBIT rotation. Congress remains mixed: Rep. Michael Rulli disclosed another GOOGL partial sale (24 Aug transaction, filed next-day 25 Aug) after previously buying the name in June.
signals.takeaway: Institutional conviction on Alphabet keeps building even as Berkshire trims bank exposure (BAC, COF) elsewhere — the single broadest whale-consensus name this cycle, with congressional sentiment still genuinely split.

signals.name: Nvidia
signals.label: Smart money trims mega-cap AI-chip concentration
signals.detail: Bridgewater cut its Nvidia stake 18% in Q2 2026 while rotating into energy/power names (Vistra +116%); Appaloosa cut Micron ~41% despite the stock surging 240%+ in the quarter; Tiger Global trimmed Nvidia and Broadcom to fund a new AMD stake. Three separate funds pared AI-chip concentration the same quarter, even as none turned outright bearish.
signals.takeaway: A genuine, multi-fund profit-taking/diversification rotation out of the most crowded AI-chip trade, not a broad AI thesis reversal — funds are redeploying into either second-tier chip names (AMD) or an entirely different sector (power/energy).

signals.name: Advanced Micro Devices
signals.label: Emerging second-tier AI-chip conviction
signals.detail: Tiger Global opened a new ~$392M AMD stake in Q2 2026 explicitly funded by trimming Nvidia/Broadcom; the same rotation theme (mega-cap AI winners funding next-tier AI infrastructure bets) shows up across Bridgewater and Appaloosa's Q2 filings.
signals.takeaway: Watch for more funds following Tiger Global's 'swap the leader for the challenger' playbook within AI-chip exposure over the next 13F cycle.

signals.name: Visa
signals.label: Ackman's fresh conviction bet on payments infrastructure
signals.detail: Pershing Square opened a new ~$1.12B Visa stake in Q2 2026 (5.4% of the portfolio) alongside new Mastercard and S&P Global positions, funded partly by fully exiting Alphabet and divesting UMG.
signals.takeaway: A single-fund but high-conviction (>$1B, >5% of book) new position from an activist known for concentrated bets — Ackman has said Pershing Square USA has already deployed 95% of its $5B raise, so more fresh Q3 positions are plausible.

signals.name: Micron
signals.label: Split verdict: Soros adds while Appaloosa cuts into the rally
signals.detail: Soros Fund Management increased its Micron stake ~7.9x (to ~$25.9M, still small) in Q2 2026 on AI-memory-chip momentum, while Appaloosa cut its much larger Micron position ~41% the same quarter even as the stock surged over 240%.
signals.takeaway: A genuinely divergent read on Micron among top allocators — Soros adding into strength, Tepper harvesting gains — worth watching for which view the Q3 13Fs (due 16 Nov 2026) vindicate.

superInvestors.deepDive: The rare direct private-placement component marked a notable shift from Berkshire's historically low tech exposure outside Apple, widely read as an early signal of Abel-era portfolio philosophy.

superInvestors.name: Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation Trust

superInvestors.value: ~$3.2B prior sale; Q2 2026 portfolio ~$34.42B across 24 holdings, ~2% turnover

superInvestors.name: Duquesne Family Office (Druckenmiller)

superInvestors.deepDive: NOTABLE NEW (non-filing): around 10-11 Sep 2026 Druckenmiller published FT commentary arguing US borrowing costs are still 'a little low,' predicting the 10-year yield reaches 5.50%, and criticizing Treasury's doubled long-bond buybacks as masking fiscal pressure — consistent with his fund's more diversified, less megacap-tech-concentrated positioning.

superInvestors.name: Pershing Square (Ackman)
superInvestors.rationale: Pershing Square's Q2 2026 13F disclosed new stakes in Visa, Mastercard, S&P Global and Netflix (re-entering after a loss-making 2022 position), while fully exiting Alphabet and divesting UMG after a rejected takeover bid; portfolio expanded from 10 to 14 positions, growing to $19.47B.
superInvestors.deepDive: In his semi-annual letter Ackman said Pershing Square USA (the permanent-capital vehicle launched April 2026) has already deployed 95% of the $5B raised, calling current AI-infrastructure over-indexing 'a highly attractive environment' for new capital — consistent with the payments/index-provider theme added this quarter.

superInvestors.name: Bridgewater Associates (Dalio)
superInvestors.shares: Cut 18% to 3,866,195 shares; separately increased Vistra (VST) ~116% to 751,695 shares
superInvestors.rationale: Bridgewater's Q2 2026 13F showed reductions across mega-cap tech (Nvidia, Apple, Amazon, Alphabet, Microsoft) alongside a rotation into energy/power names (Vistra, Shell, Petrobras, PG&E), while SPY/IVV ETFs stayed the top two holdings; the fund added 213 new names and exited 209.
superInvestors.deepDive: Turnover of that scale is consistent with Bridgewater's systematic, diversified approach rather than a discrete high-conviction call, but the explicit chips-to-power rotation was flagged by multiple outlets as a notable macro signal.
